thread:
elaine_m: FYI partner Nimbus flagged a late-night bulk upload with all events stamped in the wrong hour (file-level +01:00). Result: duplicate credits for ~1.8k accounts. We need a repeatable mitigation and a partner contract change.

omar_k: Oof. Is this human error or an automated gateway bug?

elaine_m: Looks like gateway cutover wrote files using local time instead of UTC. They shipped a fix but already sent the bad file.

sarah_pm: Short-term: can we pause ingest for their account until they replay? Long-term: require an upload_uuid in headers and file_seq.

raj_eng: Pause is risky for downstream SLA. Alternative: quarantine suspicious rows into a "reserve" ledger bucket flagged for review. Add a tolerance rule: if event_time is outside upload_time +- 15m, mark reserve.

omar_k: I like reserve + automated reconciliation when partner replays corrected file. Also add an idempotency check using upload_uuid + event_id to catch duplicates even when event_ids differ.

elaine_m: Actionable plan: (1) Ingest: accept header upload_uuid and file_seq, store on rows. (2) Ledger: add enum status {applied,reserve,reversed}. (3) Reconcile job: nightly pass that tries 3-match strategies (exact event_hash, rounded window+amount, partner replay match). Auto-apply if confidence >=95%, manual if 50-95%.

marketplace-bot: deploybot: created task reconcile-reserve-service. Owner: @raj_eng. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/ingest/pipelines/reconcile-reserve-service/5678

raj_eng: Dev notes: store upload_uuid on usage rows (varchar), expose metrics reserve_count, auto_apply_rate, false_positive_rate. Target staging deploy EOD Thu.

sarah_pm: I'll draft contract amendment requiring upload_uuid and replay SLA (48h) and circulate to legal + partner success.

omar_k: For customer comms propose three templates: (a) internal ops alert, (b) customer-facing credit notice, (c) partner replay request.

elaine_m: I'll open a partnerships ticket and notify billing-ops. We'll auto-reverse reserve after 7 days if no partner replay.

omar_k: Sounds good. If anyone needs help with test fixtures for replay scenarios ping me. :thumbsup:

elaine_m: Thanks team — adding to Fri partnerships sync agenda.
